    Simulation rules & next steps

    One market per week. Walking is 3 km/h. Sellers bring 24 units, keep 8 at the booth, and walk to storage to restock. Sales happen only with booth coverage; restocking pauses sales. Buyers have a six-item list and take purchases to storage.

    Rain reduces demand at outdoor booths. Demand rises at lunchtime. These are editable prototype rules, not a calibrated economy. Customers are represented as demand; the moving figures are your visiting party.

    Next: vendor inventories and prices, carts and drop-off queues, shared storage capacity, then saved household supplies that carry from one week to the next. This first version starts each visit with a fresh stock and shopping list.
